country.name: Honduras
country.languagePolicy: Spanish is the default interface language. Miskitu, Garífuna and other Indigenous and Afro-Honduran language and cultural requirements need competent community and authority review; machine translation is not reviewed localization.

review.policy: No category becomes verified without a named qualified Honduran reviewer, current authoritative sources and review of national, departmental, municipal, district and institutional authority where applicable.

governanceModel.summary: Honduras combines Secretaría de Educación authority for pre-basic, basic, secondary and non-university higher education with departmental, municipal and district administration. The Universidad Nacional Autónoma de Honduras, through the higher-education system and Dirección de Educación Superior, exercises constitutionally assigned higher-education organization, direction and supervision functions.
governanceModel.territorialRule: Record the responsible Dirección Departamental, Municipal or Distrital and the precise SACE center record.
governanceModel.higherEducationRule: Verify the institution in the official Dirección de Educación Superior registry and verify each program or credential under the applicable higher-education decision.

authorities.name: Secretaría de Educación
authorities.role: national authority for pre-basic, basic, secondary and non-university education

authorities.name: SACE and USINIEH
authorities.role: official center administration and education statistics

authorities.name: Dirección de Educación Superior, UNAH
authorities.role: official higher-education system and authorized-institution registry

authorities.name: Secretaría de Niñez, Adolescencia y Familia
authorities.role: national child and family policy and protection authority

curriculum.authority: Secretaría de Educación, Dirección General de Currículo
curriculum.title: Currículo Nacional Básico
curriculum.implementationRule: Confirm the applicable level, cycle, modality, current standards or programming, and departmental or local implementation guidance.
curriculum.supplementPolicy: External materials may supplement but never replace or silently reinterpret the controlling curriculum.

schoolDirectory.scopeNotice: SACE registration covers governmental and non-governmental centers and a physical campus may contain multiple center records or services. BRASA must preserve the SACE code, level, modality, administration and record date and must not infer approval beyond the specific record.

educationStatistics.scopeNotice: Every figure must preserve academic period, update date, source, measure and filters. Historical SACE reports must not be presented as current figures.

higherEducation.authority: Dirección de Educación Superior, Universidad Nacional Autónoma de Honduras
higherEducation.authorityNotice: An institution's appearance in the authorized registry does not establish that every location, program or credential has separate current approval. Program-level evidence and decision dates must be preserved.

privacyAndSafeguarding.comprehensiveLawNotice: As reviewed on 2026-10-15, the Congreso Nacional records a personal-data protection proposal rather than proof of an enacted comprehensive law. BRASA must not present a bill as law and requires current Honduran legal review.
privacyAndSafeguarding.scopeNotice: Constitutional habeas-data protection, applicable sector rules, child-protection law and institutional consent, safeguarding and incident procedures require review before real learner participation.

completionCriteria: A qualified Honduran education reviewer is named.
National, departmental, municipal and district education responsibilities are reviewed.
Every school record preserves the specific SACE code, service, level, modality, administration and source date.
Every statistic shows academic period, last update, measure, source and filters.
Every higher-education claim identifies the institution, program, location, governing decision and effective date where applicable.
Curriculum mappings identify level, cycle, modality and current implementation guidance.
Miskitu, Garífuna and other Indigenous and Afro-Honduran language and cultural requirements are reviewed with community participation.
The status of comprehensive personal-data legislation is rechecked by qualified Honduran counsel.
Privacy, child protection, accessibility, incident and consent procedures are approved by the participating institution.
No authorization, accreditation, partnership or credential claim exceeds documentary evidence.
